name: A. N. Jeffries
role: Cattleman with a ranch down the Little Missouri
bio: A. N. Jeffries returned from Albany, Texas, in March 1886 to his ranch down the river, reporting that his company would drive about 10,000 head of cattle that year, and in April planned an outfit to work the river below the round-up district. In August 1886 he was elected vice-chairman of the Little Missouri River Stockgrowers' Association.
